How fast the fluid mesh background moves. The upstream effect was paced for a wallpaper you glance at, so the default is raised to read as motion on a playback page.
Following the music reads the energy of the audio being played. Turning it off stops all audio analysis.
Render quality sets both the internal render resolution and the frame-rate cap; the battery saver preset renders smaller and looks softer.
Lets the fluid mesh swell with the bass, the way the upstream wallpaper does. Turn off to lock the background to a steady drift and stop audio analysis entirely.
How far the background swells on each beat. Standard matches the upstream wallpaper.
